description: Identifier-style ('where is X defined') held-out evaluation set for Kalpana on Miru. Kept separate from the natural-language CodeSearchNet queries. Query rules and seed are fixed up front and not tuned on results.
rules: function/method/class/type identifier, >=8 chars, >=2 words, defined in >=2 files across 2..30 directories, tests/vendor/docs excluded (miru_kalpana/gen_queries_multi.py); tree-sitter definitions from Miru's own grammars
